item.description: title: “Project 1 Documentation” date: 2025-12-03T22:55:00-05:00 draft: false Project 1 API Documentation Books Purpose: Keep a collection of books storing relevant information such as name, author, and year. Endpoints: GET /books: Returns all books GET /books/{id}: Returns a specific book based on the id POST /books: Creates a new book in the database PUT/PATCH /books/{id}: Modifies an already existing book based on the id DELETE /books/{id}: Removes a book from the database based on the id
